remarks:
ENDLESS POSSIBILITIES! Bring your vision to life with this versatile, character-filled property located in the heart of the bustling Medical Corridor! Currently zoned as a two-family residence and previously utilized as a mixed-use commercial property with a business and apartment, this unique building offers an exciting opportunity for investors and owner-occupants alike.

Step inside and discover the architectural charm just waiting to be brought back to life! Hardwood floors, expansive rooms, soaring vaulted ceilings, and a grand winding staircase provide the perfect foundation for something truly special.

The property features separate unit entrances, a two-car block garage, several additional parking spaces, and a front concrete pad previously used for parking that offers even more possibilities for creative use.

Several significant improvements have been completed within the past three years, including a rebuilt exterior wall, new water lines, and repairs to the original windows. Previous architectural plans for conversion to a two-family residence are available upon request.

Whether you're envisioning an income-producing investment, an owner-occupied residence, or exploring future possibilities, this property offers a chance to be part of the continued revitalization of Buffalo's Medical Corridor.


Schedule your private showing and discover the possibilities waiting behind these doors!
